title: Amazing tour and guide
text: We had an amazing tour experience with our guide Eduardo. He was incredibly knowledgeable, funny, and helpful as we toured the magnificent Alhambra. His historical and plant knowledge was very impressive. Would definitely use this tour group again.
author: tman4lom

title: Brilliant guide!
text: My husband is a really smart and well read guy. So I asked for a guide who really knows the Alhambra and wow, did we get our guy! Carlos must be an academic because he quoted other academics, he referenced books, he brought pictures. It was incredible. I was in awe of the Alhambra and my husband was thrilled to speak with Carlos about the history of the palace, the gates, the families who lived there, the religious iconography. Amazing! Totally worth the price.
author: Lalo_misu_juancho
